project.name: DC Platform :: Security :: Authz :: API
project.description:
RequiresPermission: declarative method/type-level permission enforcement, bridged to a PermissionEvaluatorProvider (platform-security-authz-spi) by the authz autoconfiguration.
Artifact naming: prefixed platform-security-authz-* (not platform-authz-*) so the dependency constitution's per-capability grouping (enforced by PlatformLayerRule, which infers capability from the artifactId's first segment) treats authz as part of the security capability family, matching the phase-06 spec's single "security/" section covering both. This lets platform-security-authz-spi legitimately depend on platform-security-api's CurrentUser as a same-capability api dependency (decision D25, docs/decisions/decision-log.md) rather than fighting the enforcer with a cross-capability edge the SPI layer has no allowance for.
